case.title: Ransomware encryption activity on KCTLAB-WIN01
case.desc: Files on KCTLAB-WIN01 were encrypted by active ransomware. Rapid containment isolated the system within 2 minutes.

organization.name: Kumaraguru College of Technology
organization.address: Athipalayam Road, Chinnavedampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641049
organization.dpo_title: Data Protection Officer & Head of IT

steps.title: Isolate the affected system
steps.command_executed: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,blockoutbound
steps.notes: Affected computer disconnected from the network to stop active encryption.

steps.title: Identify the ransomware activity
steps.notes: Ransomware process identified (PID 4892) with outbound beaconing to 185.220.101.5.

steps.title: Preserve evidence
steps.notes: Desktop screenshots and netstat connections preserved as forensic evidence.

steps.title: Block the attacker connection
steps.notes: Malicious remote connection dropped at endpoint and firewall.

steps.title: Stop the malicious process
steps.notes: Ransomware process terminated. File encryption halted.

steps.title: Restore from backup
steps.notes: System restored from clean immutable backup.

steps.title: Verify recovery and generate report
steps.command_executed: ZeroDashboard UI -> Click 'Generate Statutory Report Package'
steps.notes: Recovery verified. DPDP Section 8(6) statutory report compiled.

recommendations: Enforce multi-factor authentication across all Windows administrative logons.
Isolate lab subnets from internal administrative database servers.
Verify off-site immutable backup schedules every 24 hours.
